text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're making steady progress on our
plans to
bring back the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please stop by and check out our
concert! All are
welcome! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was my last flyer. Gotta go
get—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Here you are!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get started on that
special lesson
you asked for.

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it. Now then—
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いします！
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, almost forgot! I went ahead and sent
you the
dance videos you asked for.

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, great! I really wanted to take
inspiration from
that group for the
choreography.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm fine. I'm hardly going above
and
beyond.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
After all, offering this kind of support is
about all
I can do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, the outdoor stage is free right now,
and I was
thinking... Could we try an
impromptu concert?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for coming!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaand no one's here. So much for
stardom...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Gah... I'll never give up! Not till I make
everyone's
hearts throb!
choice_data_list: 今回はお試しで、ゲリラライブだったから
choice_data_list_en: This time was just a test run, plus it was a guerilla concert, so...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting... this...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-oh, yeah, you're right! Let's
make our
next concert bigger!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Falco's performance was impeccable,
but we still
failed to gather a crowd. It
must be because I
haven't done enough
to promote our project...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? No, no, this is totally
different!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...You think so?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know so! See, what happened is I failed
to get
across just how fun concerts can
be!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It sucks, yeah, but we just have to put
our heads
together and think about how
we can steal
everyone's hearts at the
real concert!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: A concert that'll steal people's hearts...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That includes you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up the impromptu
concert, we
take some time to discuss
next steps. Then, on
the way home...
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, let's think about it together!
Yeah, let's think about it together!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, s-sorry! We'll do better next time!
Next time,
I'll...
choice_data_list_en: You don't seem to have much energy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... That would be lovely, if you
don't mind.
choice_data_list: とりあえず、ご飯にでも行きませんか？
choice_data_list_en: For now, shall we go get a meal or something?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What? No, I should be thanking you!
Really, I
don't know what I'd do without
you two.
choice_data_list: 準備、いつもお疲れ様です
choice_data_list_en: Thank you as always for handling the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
They really are tricky, aren't they?
Concerts.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Well, actually, um...
choice_data_list: もしかしてライブは……得意ではない？
choice_data_list_en: Are concerts... not really your thing?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I... don't have a whole lot of experience
with
them.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't tell you what it takes to make
a concert
a success... or even what a
successful concert
looks like, really.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I want to create something that everyone on stage can enjoy with a smile.
choice_data_list: であれば、なぜグランドライブの企画を？
choice_data_list_en: If that's the case, why organize the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even those backstage, where no
spotlight
shines...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's why I'm doing this. And I
need to
work harder to make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I intend to put all of myself into this

project—everything I've learned from my
work up
until now!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me to share a
meal with
you! I'll get the bill.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I know what I need to do now—study up
on how
to make a concert that'll capture
people's hearts,
like Falco said!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can get a word in, Light Hello
pays the
bill and dashes out of the
restaurant, still looking
a little on edge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, we're at the school
gates,
handing out flyers for our first
concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Grand Concert... concert... Yes,
that's it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I've overlooked something
so
simple! Concerts! Why, I've hardly
incorporated
them into the research at
all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Crowd density, conformity... the "wave"
even.
Something here could hold the
potential to affect
both brain matter and
bodily stimulation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... I look forward to the first day of observations. And on the big day, I might like to bring her along as well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...W-wait a second. So does that mean
you're
gonna help us?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All in all, preparations for our first
concert are
going smoothly.
